Name: Peachy Objects
Author: peachitto
Description:
[center]what started as wanting to edit a few objects on the springobjects tile sheet has spiraled into this: Peachy Objects. i like the simple charm of the vanilla art, so this is more focused on changing colors and slight shading alterations. with [i]some[/i] entirely new art.[/center][center]this mod replaces many things on said tilesheet, as well as all the tools and a few weapons. also all of the crop's grow states and some monsters (in order to match).

----------[/center]
here is the current rundown of this mod:
[list]
[*][b]replaces [i]a lot[/i] (but not all) of the items in the springobjects tile sheet. and some new objects added in 1.6 in the Objects_2 tilesheet.[/b]
[*][b]replaces all crops growth states.[/b]
[*][b]replaces certain monsters to match my object edits. [/b](false magma cap, iridium crab, dangerous lava crab, and stick bug)
[*][b]replaces all tools.[/b]
[*][b]replaces a small selection weapons.[/b]
[*][b]replaces the star quality indicator on items[/b] [b]with colors matching my edits.[/b]
[/list][b]
[/b][center]----------[/center]
what's configurable?
[list]
[*][b]the trellis[/b] [b]color[/b] for the crops: dark, brown, light, white, or old (default: brown)
[*][b]iridium's color[/b] scheme: purple, pale, pink, black, or blue (default: purple) (note: the black color is inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4366]6480's Oil iridium recolor[/url]﻿)
[/list]

now there are [b]two different routes you can go for disabling some changes[/b].

[list]
[*]the first way, for if you only know how to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿:
[/list]you can quickly [b]disable some features entirely[/b] by setting them to [b]false[/b]. [b]these go by sections and match exactly with the preview images[/b]. the only sections i don't have images for are: [b]CropsMap[/b] (crop growth stages), [b]Aquarium Fish [/b](for the aquarium sprites),[b] BarnCoop Craftables[/b] (a matching recolor for hay/eggs in the hopper/incubator), [b]QualityStars[/b] (the star quality indicator on items), and [b]Monsters[/b] (they match the objects they are associated with).
there is also ONE option for individually disabling something: the torch. this is because i'm actually using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20333]orangeblossom7's firefly torch[/url], and it's my personal favorite right now. but let me be clear: [u]i am not writing a config for 400+ individual items. i'm sorry.[/u] if someone else is willing to do this, that's fine. i know other modders have done this, but other modders are smarter than me and didn't bundle everything in one mod. and i don't feel like changing it now. :(

[list]
[*]the second way, for if you know how to navigate a folder on PC:
[/list]you can [b]individually disable images from taking effect by deleting or renaming them[/b]. nothing should break if you do this. just obviously don't rename something to another image that could be used. there are some things that are linked that will be disabled if you disable their "parent" image. the stick bug, for example, will be disabled if you delete the image for branches. [s]but you probably wouldn't want that anyway, right?
[/s]
you can of course use both of these methods, but the second one is redundant in the case of you disabling the image's section anyway.
